+                self._escape = False
+                pos += 1
+            elif ch == "[":
+                self._mode = "container"
+                self._stack = ["]"]
+                self._in_string = False
+                self._escape = False

+                    closed, pos = self._scan_string(text, pos)
+                    if closed:
+                        self._in_string = False
+                        continue
+                    break
+                match = _CONTAINER_SPECIAL_RE.search(text, pos)
+                if match is None:
+                    pos = n

+                c = text[idx]

+                elif c == "{":

+            if eof:

+            closed, pos = self._scan_string(text, pos)
+            if closed:
+                return self._finish_token(text, start, pos), pos
+            if pos > start:

+                    self._state = "array_start"
+                else:
+                    self._state = "single"
+            elif self._state == "single":
+                if not self._scanner.active and pos >= n:
+                    return
+                token, pos = self._scanner.scan(text, pos, eof=eof)
+                if token is None:
+                    return
+                self._pending_single = self._decoder.decode(token)
+                self._has_pending_single = True
+                self._state = "trailing"
